changePassword.title: Change Your Password
changePassword.subtitle: Your account must set a new password before you can continue. Choose a strong password you have not used before.
changePassword.voluntarySubtitle: Update your sign-in password and enhance credentials. Regular rotations protect against unauthorized access.
changePassword.forcedSubtitle: This account requires a password rotation before you can access the console.
changePassword.success: Password updated. Please sign in with your new password.
changePassword.mismatch: New password and confirmation do not match
changePassword.ruleDifferent: Must be different from current password
changePassword.invalidComplexity: New password must meet security requirements (at least 12 characters, uppercase, lowercase, and digits)
changePassword.tipUniqueDesc: Never reuse passwords across different platforms to guard against credential stuffing.
changePassword.tipRotationDesc: The platform strictly blocks reusing recently used passwords to ensure genuine credential hygiene.
changePassword.tipSessionDesc: After changing your password, your active session will expire immediately and require re-authentication.
